Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data transcription error in the "Analysis of Previous Result" section of Step 4. While the WebSurfer correctly identified the release date of Aami as "9 February 2018", the Planner incorrectly wrote it as "9 February 2008" in the summary. This typo led to a logical contradiction where the Planner concluded that Bitch Slap (2009) was more recent than Aami (2008), whereas the correct comparison (2018 vs 2009) would show Aami is the more recent film. This error matches the pattern of misreporting explicit temporal data found in Example 2.
